description.mn: Afnan Her Highness Black: Эмэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан модлог үнэр (EDP).
description.en: Her Highness Black by Afnan Perfume. Every woman can feel like a royalty thanks to Her Highness Black. This tantalizing perfume embodies the confidence bestowed upon a royal with the bold power of self-sufficiency and independence that can turn any woman into the queen of her world. Seductive, bold and sophisticated, this fragrance is a complementary blend of delectable plums immersed in an intoxicating bouquet of tuberose, jasmine and ylang-ylang. A dash of pink pepper kicks the scent up a notch, adding an invigorating spiciness to the long-lasting aroma.
